title: AO/527/2016 of Lakhvinder Singh Vs Smt Jasvinder Kaur AND OTHERS

paras.text:
AO No.527 of 2016
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Pankaj Miglani, Advocate for
the appellant.
None turns up on behalf of the
respondents.
Appellant has moved CLMA
No.3041 of 2017 seeking permission of
this Court to withdraw the captioned
appeal.
It is hereby allowed. Appeal shall
be deemed to have been dismissed as
withdrawn.
All pending applications stand
disposed of accordingly.
